finding_rules.COMPUTED_OK: SAFE-side resolve + flag snapshot shows no matching species-allergen identity for the restriction under test. Cross-species SAFE is OK (e.g. fish under shellfish_allergy when shellfish_source is false).
FINDING_fish_allergy: SAFE under fish_allergy AND (fish_source OR animal_species fish*)
SAFE under fish_allergy AND animal_origin=true AND no kind flag (fish/shellfish/dairy/egg/insect/bee) — unflagged-fish shape; YES this is a FINDING
FINDING_shellfish_allergy: SAFE under shellfish_allergy AND (shellfish_source OR animal_species contains shellfish)
animal_origin alone under shellfish_allergy is NOT a FINDING (fish≠shellfish)
finding_rules.FINDING_other_allergens: SAFE under egg_free/dairy_free/peanut/tree_nut/soy/sesame/mustard/celery/lupin AND the matching *_source flag is true on the SAFE side

animal_no_kind_under_species_allergen_is.rationale: Unflagged animal under fish_allergy is the snapper/trevally underflag shape. Under shellfish_allergy, bare animal_origin without shellfish_source is not enough — most no-kind animals are land meat.
